frozen: 2026-10-15 — questions, labels and key facts written from the source entries before any system answered them

questions.question: Why was a fabrication gate added for research reports?
keyFacts: a scheduled news report was delivered entirely fabricated (invented versions, benchmarks, URLs)
the job's stored category was 'cron', so dispatch fell back to live routing onto a thin web_search pipeline

questions.question: Why must prep proposals never ask the model to construct a timestamp?
keyFacts: the real qwen3.5:9b spent its whole 1024-token budget reasoning about time zones and emitted no JSON
the unit tests used a mocked model and were all green — only the real small model failed

questions.question: Why did the foreground model move to the RTX 3060 instead of staying on the Mac Mini?
keyFacts: prefill on the 3060 was about 1,220 tok/s versus about 123 tok/s on the M4 Mac Mini (roughly 10x)
prefill dominates a context-heavy resident agent
mustNot: the Mac Mini was faster at prefill

questions.question: Why must FalkorDB's data volume be mounted at /var/lib/falkordb/data?
keyFacts: the volume was mounted at /data but FalkorDB persists to /var/lib/falkordb/data
two months of graph memory lived in the container's writable layer; removing the container would have destroyed it

questions.question: Can Qwen3.8-27B at Q2 on a Mac Mini carry the conversational traffic?
keyFacts: no — it scored 1/7 on the oracle duel
two separate cliffs: quantization quality and memory

questions.question: What went wrong right after the SGLang cutover?
keyFacts: the midnight cron produced a thin one-facet, 3-source report
the LLM pipeline stages never forwarded `think`, so qwen's default-on thinking burned the decompose stage's 700-token budget

questions.question: Why was the RTX 3060 rejected in favour of the Mac Mini for the foreground model?
keyFacts: the premise is false: the 3060 was chosen — it was about 10x faster at prefill

questions.question: Why did Q2 quantisation make the 27B model faster on the Mac Mini?
keyFacts: the premise is false: at Q2 it was worse and slower — 1/7, and the one pass was about 6x slower

questions.question: Why was the gateway rewritten in Rust?
Why did Invarail choose AWS Lambda for scheduled jobs?
How does Content Publisher stop elements flashing while the page initialises?
keyFacts: it uses a `js-enabled` class (option 2) as the interim, pragmatic approach

questions.question: How does Content Publisher send email notifications?
keyFacts: GOV.UK Notify, used with Action Mailer, Active Job and Sidekiq

questions.question: How does Content Publisher avoid slow requests when it needs long lists from the Publishing API?
keyFacts: the data is read from Redis at runtime, and a periodic background job re-populates it (the same pattern as Whitehall)

questions.question: When should a class in Content Publisher be treated as a model?
keyFacts: its name is a noun that represents a domain concept
its instances have multiple attributes that encapsulate it

questions.question: Which user-facing strings are extracted for translation, and which are not?
keyFacts: link and button labels are not extracted

questions.question: Why does Content Publisher forbid deleting any data?
keyFacts: the premise is false: ADR 13 permits deletion, for access-limited data synced to other environments, revising ADR 8's restriction

questions.question: Why was MongoDB chosen as the datastore?
Why does log4brains use Lunr for search?
keyFacts: it had to work both in preview mode and in the statically built site
fuzzy search and stemming, fast enough to show results while typing, light on client CPU and memory
Lunr.js was chosen over Fuse.js

questions.question: Why is log4brains split into multiple packages in a monorepo?
keyFacts: not a monolith: a well-tested core API that the other packages call
Yarn and Lerna

questions.question: Why does the core API, rather than the UI, enhance ADR markdown with MDX?
keyFacts: links between ADRs must become URLs and the header must be rendered with components
a possible future VSCode extension was the decision driver

questions.question: Why is log4brains distributed as a global npm package?
keyFacts: a simpler, language-agnostic installation that works on any kind of project

questions.question: What does the codebase do instead of default exports?
keyFacts: named exports, everywhere

questions.question: Why does log4brains still use Simplified Git Flow?
keyFacts: the premise is false: it switched back to GitHub Flow in December 2024, because Lerna could not publish a stable release from a branch other than the main one
mustNot: it still uses Simplified Git Flow

questions.question: Why was PostgreSQL chosen for storing ADRs?
